The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Summary of Cause & Fix
- **Root Cause**: In [`DSCompiler.atan2`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_10_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/analysis/differentiation/DSCompiler.java#L1382), when both arguments are signed zeros (`+/-0.0`), the intermediate computation `y / (r +/- x)` evaluates to `0.0 / 0.0`, resulting in `Double.NaN` for the function value component rather than the IEEE 754 expected signed zero or `+/-PI`.
- **Fix**: In [`DSCompiler.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_10_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/analysis/differentiation/DSCompiler.java#L1419), assigned `result[resultOffset] = FastMath.atan2(y[yOffset], x[xOffset]);` under the special cases section to ensure the value component strictly adheres to IEEE 754 standard special cases.
- **Verification**: Ran `org.apache.commons.math3.analysis.differentiation.DerivativeStructureTest::testAtan2SpecialCases` and verified that 0 tests failed.
- **Patch**: Exported the source code modification to [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_10_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
